overview: A daily job listing portal for Government, Private, and Corporate jobs. Visitors can search and filter open positions; admins can log in to post, edit, and manage job listings via a dedicated admin panel.
features: Browse government, private, and corporate jobs
Search by job title and location
Filter by job type, location, and salary range
Full job detail pages with description and requirements
Protected admin panel with Internet Identity login
Post, edit, and delete job listings from admin panel
Responsive design for mobile and desktop
